log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon
|-damage|p1a: Incineroar|177/202|[from] ability: Rough Skin|[of] p2a: Garchomp

decisions.thought: Opponent has Primarina and Incineroar threatening Kingambit and Garchomp. Gholdengo blocks status and pressures Primarina, Garchomp leads well with Sash + Rocks, and Sylveon covers Dragonite/Garchomp. Bring Garchomp, Gholdengo, Sylveon.
Incineroar lead gives Intimidate and Fake Out control vs Kingambit/Dragonite. Primarina covers Garchomp and Sylveon, Kingambit beats Gholdengo.

Garchomp outspeeds Incineroar and Earthquake hits it super effective, likely dealing heavy damage or KOing. Setting rocks is also fine, but punishing the Intimidate lead with damage is better since Incineroar usually U-turns anyway.
Incineroar is slower than Garchomp, so Fake Out's +3 priority is the deciding factor. It guarantees a flinch and free chip on turn 1 before Garchomp can attack.
Fake Out is spent, so Incineroar can't flinch me this turn. I'm faster and Earthquake is super effective, dealing big damage while I keep momentum and my Focus Sash intact.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Incineroar likely Fake Out again? No, Fake Out only first turn. Earthquake hits hard; Incineroar bulky but SE. EQ is best.

decisions.thought: Garchomp outspeeds and threatens Earthquake, while Incineroar can't KO with Flare Blitz. Parting Shot further drops its offenses and pivots out safely.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating a Parting Shot pivot to Primarina versus Garchomp given type matchups and attack reduction.

decisions.thought: Garchomp is locked into Earthquake and at -2 Attack. Kingambit is weak to Ground while Primarina takes it neutrally and threatens back super-effectively.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating switch-in options between Primarina and Kingambit against Garchomp's Earthquake given type matchups and stat changes.

decisions.thought: Garchomp is at -2 Attack, so Earthquake is weak, and Primarina resists nothing but can hit back hard with Moonblast/Hydro Pump. Setting Stealth Rock now is the best value while we outspeed, pressuring Incineroar and future picks like Dragonite.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Garchomp at -2 Atk, EQ does little to Primarina (resist? Ground vs Water/Fairy is neutral... actually Water resists? No—Ground is neutral vs Water/Fairy). Garchomp -2 EQ weak. Better: Stealth Rock while Primarina threatens. Or switch Gholdengo to wall Primarina. Gholdengo resists Water? No, Steel/Ghost: Water neutral, Fairy neutral... Primarina Moonblast hits Gholdengo neutrally. Gholdengo good switch. But Stealth Rock is valuable. Primarina likely faster? No, we outspeed. EQ at -2 still decent chip. I'll go Stealth Rock.

decisions.thought: Garchomp is faster but at -2 Attack and Moonblast is super effective. Moonblast should KO before Earthquake threatens.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating type matchups and damage to choose between Moonblast and defensive play for Primarina versus Garchomp.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo resists Moonblast (Steel halves Fairy) and threatens Primarina hard with Make It Rain, while Sylveon would get pressured by Moonblast. Gholdengo is the safe, punishing switch.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Primarina threatens Gholdengo? Gholdengo resists Fairy? No—Fairy is neutral on Steel, Ghost weak to... Primarina Moonblast hits Gholdengo neutrally (Steel resists? Fairy vs Steel is resisted, Ghost neutral → 0.5x). Gholdengo good switch, resists Moonblast, threatens Primarina with Make It Rain.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo outspeeds Primarina and Good as Gold blocks status. Make It Rain with Life Orb deals solid neutral damage and pressures Primarina before it can Moonblast; Nasty Plot risks taking a hit first.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Primarina likely resists Steel? Water/Fairy: Steel neutral (Fairy weak to Steel, Water resists? Steel is neutral on Water, super on Fairy → net neutral... actually Water resists Steel? No, Steel is not resisted by Water; Fairy weak → 2x/0.5 = neutral). Make It Rain neutral hit with Life Orb, likely big damage but not KO. Shadowball also neutral. Nasty Plot risks Moonblast. Make It Rain best pressure.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo resists Moonblast and outspeeds Primarina, so staying in is a bad matchup. Flip Turn chips it and pivots safely into Kingambit which resists its STABs.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokemon matchup and move options to choose Flip Turn for a safe pivot to Kingambit.

decisions.thought: Primarina must pivot out after Flip Turn. Kingambit resists Make It Rain and takes minimal Stealth Rock chip, while Incineroar would drop to ~18% and can't Fake Out Ghost.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating forced switch mechanics and type matchups to pick between Incineroar and Kingambit.

decisions.thought: Kingambit resists both Make It Rain and Shadow Ball, and Gholdengo is at -2 SpA, so attacking does little. Nasty Plot is safe since Sucker Punch fails against a status move and Good as Gold blocks status. We outspeed, so we can sweep later with boosted Make It Rain.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Kingambit resists both STABs; Gholdengo -2 SpA. Nasty Plot while Kingambit likely can't threaten much? Kingambit could Sucker Punch/Knock Off. Gholdengo immune to status via Good as Gold. Nasty Plot is risky but Kingambit's Sucker Punch only works if we attack. Nasty Plot then next turn Make It Rain boosted. But Sucker Punch fails vs Nasty Plot. Good pick.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo is at 59% and faster, but at -2 its Steel move is resisted. Sucker Punch has priority and is super effective, securing the KO before any Fighting coverage.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Pokemon matchup damage, priority, and type effectiveness to choose between Sucker Punch and Kowtow.

decisions.thought: Kingambit resists both Make It Rain and Shadow Ball, so attacking now does little. Last turn its Sucker Punch failed against Nasty Plot, and it may repeat that mistake; boosting again is low-risk since Good as Gold blocks status and we outspeed.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Kingambit resists both STABs; Nasty Plot again is risky vs Sucker Punch (fails on status). Kingambit likely Sucker Punch again—Nasty Plot is status, Sucker fails again. But they may switch. Nasty Plot is fine; Make It Rain is resisted (0.5x? Steel vs Dark/Steel: Steel resisted by Steel, Dark neutral... actually Steel vs Dark is 1x, vs Steel 0.5 → 0.5x). Shadow Ball also 0.5x. So Nasty Plot again.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo is at +2 and faster, so it will likely attack now to KO. Sucker Punch has priority and is super effective, securing the KO before it moves.

Kingambit only has Sucker Punch, which fails against status, but I'm already at +4 and faster. Make It Rain at +4 with Life Orb should KO Kingambit even resisted, ending the biggest threat before it can act.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Kingambit only has Sucker Punch revealed; +4 Gholdengo. Sucker Punch fails vs Nasty Plot again? They may switch or attack. Make It Rain is resisted but with +4 and Life Orb likely KOs Kingambit (94% HP, resisted 120 BP +4... 185 SPA, 120*0.5*2.25... likely KO). Safer: Make It Rain.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo is faster and at +4 after double Nasty Plot, so it will attack now. Priority Sucker Punch hits first for super-effective STAB KO.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating type matchups and damage calculations for Kingambit versus Gholdengo with Sucker Punch and Make It Rain.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo fainted, so I must send in Sylveon. Kingambit is 4x weak to Fairy and Sylveon's Pixilate Hyper Voice will hit it hard, while Kingambit's Sucker Punch can't touch Sylveon meaningfully. Primarina and Incineroar are both nearly dead on their bench.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Switch Sylveon; Kingambit likely Sucker Punch/weak to Fairy. Sylveon Hyper Voice hits hard.

decisions.thought: Hyper Voice is resisted by Kingambit, so Yawn is best: it forces Kingambit to switch or fall asleep next turn, letting me set up Wish safely afterward. Sylveon is at full HP so Sucker Punch isn't a KO threat.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Sylveon vs Kingambit: Hyper Voice is resisted. Yawn forces Kingambit out or sleep. Yawn is good—Kingambit must switch or sleep. But Sucker Punch threat... Yawn is safe.

decisions.thought: Ironhead is super effective on Sylveon and Kingambit can tank a neutral Fairy hit, so staying in to attack is best.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Kingambit damage and speed matchup versus Sylveon under current HP and ability conditions.
